RESOLVED. Fix merged to main as 1ab54b3042 via Gerrit change 2028 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2028), LLM-Review +1 (rebar review bot) + Verified +1 (rebar CI bot), submitted with all CI matrix jobs green including pytest on macos-latest.

Change: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_ref_lock.py adds a _bare_git helper using explicit 'git --git-dir <bare.git>' naming (the _git_upkeep prior-art pattern) and routes the AC0 test's two bare-remote inspections (cat-file -t, rev-parse) through it; work-tree repos keep 'git -C'. No production code changed.

Acceptance criteria verified:
- Root cause with cited mechanism: recorded in the previous comment (safe.bareRepository=explicit injected via GIT_CONFIG_* refuses implicit discovery of bare repos → git -C exit 128; --git-dir permitted).
- Test passes in this environment: 5x consecutive passes under the ambient explicit policy, plus the whole module under GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 (default policy) — both postures green, mirroring test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py.
- Full reconciler suite green: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/ 3032 passed, 0 failed (plus the module re-run green on merged main).

Standing 'ignore only this test' guidance is now obsolete — the test is portable to hosts that inject the explicit bare-repo policy.
